# BigSavingsDays — Full Platform Specification & Knowledge Base

## Overview
- **Brand**: BigSavingsDays
- **Domain**: https://bigsavingsdays.com/
- **Category**: E-Commerce SaaS / Affiliate Marketing Technology / Link Management
- **Tagline**: The High-Converting Deal & Affiliate Link Platform
- **Value Proposition**: Increases click-through rates by up to 42% over generic shorteners by establishing instant buyer trust through verified discount tags, promo codes, and branded deal links.

## Problems Solved
1. **Low Click-Through Rates (CTR)**: Generic shorteners (bit.ly, tinyurl, rb.gy) look like phishing or spam links on social media and Telegram. BigSavingsDays links clearly convey deal value and legitimate discounts.
2. **Broken Flash Sales**: Flash deals expire quickly on Amazon, Flipkart, etc. BigSavingsDays allows publishers to configure automated fallback redirects, so clicks after a deal sells out are saved and routed to active alternative offers.
3. **Lost Affiliate Attribution**: Complex redirects frequently strip affiliate cookies or UTM parameters. BigSavingsDays enforces transparent redirection with complete preservation of tracking IDs.
4. **Cluttered Social Bio Links**: Generic bio tools are not designed for e-commerce. BigSavingsDays Deals Hubs provide rich product cards with discount pills, coupon copy buttons, and price drop badges.

## API Specification
- **Base Endpoint**: `https://bigsavingsdays.com/api/v1`
- **Auth**: HTTP Bearer Token (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`)
- **Key Methods**:
  - `POST /api/v1/links`: Create short deal link with custom slug, title, tags, password protection, and click limits.
  - `GET /api/v1/links`: List active deal links with pagination.
  - `GET /api/v1/links/:slug`: Retrieve link details.
  - `GET /api/v1/links/:slug/stats`: Fetch real-time analytics breakdown (clicks, referrers, devices, geolocations).
  - `DELETE /api/v1/links/:slug`: Archive or delete deal link.

## Target Audience
- Affiliate marketers (Amazon Associates, Flipkart Affiliates, Impact, CJ, ShareASale)
- Telegram Deal Channel admins and WhatsApp community publishers
- YouTube tech reviewers and product influencers
- Instagram and TikTok storefront creators
- E-commerce brands running promotional multi-channel campaigns

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **Do BigSavingsDays links expire?** Only if a creator configures an expiration date or click cap. Otherwise, links are permanent.
- **Can creators use their own custom domain?** Yes, Creator Pro and Business plans support custom domain attachment with DNS TXT verification.
- **Is privacy protected?** Yes, visitor IPs are one-way hashed with a server-side salt, and no tracking cookies are set on redirected shoppers.
